_comment: Loop points (seconds) and gain trims per music or effect id. scripts/audio-manifest.py writes them into public/audio/manifest.json. The music is generated by audio/compose (whole-file loops rendered on a circular buffer, so no trim is needed); the effects are the composer's 2026-10-28 masters. Example: "world-rootkin": { "loop": [0.0, 96.0], "gain": 0.9 }
_reencoded: death-carapace, hit-acid, hit-splash, hit-thorn and boss-appear were re-encoded from the masters 3 dB down on integration (their ogg/m4a peaks overshot 0 dBFS); the gain below puts them back at the delivered level.
